### Renovate Ignore Notification

As this PR has been closed unmerged, Renovate will now ignore this update (2.22.1). You will still receive a PR once a newer version is released, so if you wish to permanently ignore this dependency, please add it to the `ignoreDeps` array of your renovate config.

If this PR was closed by mistake or you changed your mind, you can simply rename this PR and you will soon get a fresh replacement PR opened.
